name: Dassault Mirage F1
summary: French swept-wing single-engine supersonic fighter now operated in the US by contractor adversary-training companies; flown as a civil-registered adversary aircraft.

wings: High-set, strongly swept wing with extended leading-edge slats
Wing pylons that often carry drop tanks or missiles
engines: Single SNECMA Atar turbojet with a large round afterburner nozzle
Two fixed half-round intakes on the fuselage sides beside the cockpit
fuselage: Long, slender pointed nose with a pitot probe on the radome
Bubble canopy on a long fuselage

tellTales: Swept high wing and a long pointed nose with a probe on a single-engine fighter
Fixed half-round side intakes beside the cockpit
One large engine nozzle and a tall single fin with a low tailplane

confusedWith.howToTell: The F-5 is a smaller twin-engine fighter with a straight wing and long chin-line LERX; the F1 is single-engine with a strongly swept high wing.
The F-16 has a chin intake and bubble canopy with a blended wing; the F1 has two side intakes and a distinctive swept wing.
The Sabre is a subsonic jet with a nose intake; the F1 has side intakes and a bigger afterburner nozzle.
